{{Short description|Mexican mathematician and computer scientist}}
{{family name hatnote|Urrutia||lang=Spanish}}
[[File:JorgeUrrutia.jpg|thumb|At LATIN 2016]]
'''Jorge Urrutia Galicia''' is a Mexican mathematician and computer scientist in the Institute of Mathematics of the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM).<ref>[http://www.fciencias.unam.mx/directorio/34311 Faculty profile], UNAM, retrieved 2015-03-23.</ref> His research primarily concerns [[discrete geometry|discrete]] and [[computational geometry]].

==Education and career==
Urrutia earned his Ph.D. from the [[University of Waterloo]] in 1980, under the supervision of [[Ronald C. Read]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=72995|name=Jorge Urrutia}}</ref>
He worked for many years at the [[University of Ottawa]] before moving to UNAM in 1999.<ref name="about">[http://www.matem.unam.mx/jorgefest/jorge.html Jorge Urrutia Galicia] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402132610/http://www.matem.unam.mx/jorgefest/jorge.html |date=2015-04-02 }}, Mexican Conference on Discrete Mathematics and Computational Geometry, retrieved 2015-03-23.</ref>
With [[Jörg-Rüdiger Sack]] in 1991, he was founding co-editor-in-chief of the [[academic journal]] ''[[Computational Geometry (journal)|Computational Geometry: Theory and Applications]]''.<ref>{{citation|title=Computational Geometry: Theory and Applications |url=http://www.computingreviews.com/review/review_review.cfm?review_id=115947 |journal=[[ACM Computing Reviews]] |date=September 1993 |at=Review #CR115947 |first=Joseph |last=O’Rourke |authorlink=Joseph O'Rourke (professor) }}</ref>

==Recognition==
Urrutia is a member of the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.amc.mx/amc/membresia/MATEMATICAS2021.pdf|title=Mathematics section members|publisher=Mexican Academy of Sciences|year=2021|access-date=2022-11-18}}</ref> The Mexican Conference on Discrete Mathematics and Computational Geometry, held in 2013 in [[Oaxaca]], was dedicated to Urrutia in honor of his 60th birthday.<ref>[http://www.matem.unam.mx/jorgefest/ Mexican Conference on Discrete Mathematics and Computational Geometry] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402145717/http://www.matem.unam.mx/jorgefest/ |date=2015-04-02 }}, retrieved 2015-03-23.</ref>
